source.statement: Maintainer decision under ROOT-REVIEW-001: CORE-PLATFORM-001 0.6.0 adopts the CORE-025 watch publication and retention subsection in decisions/CORE-025-watch-publication-retention.md and its test vectors, within contract version 0.4.0. A publication is acknowledged when the upload succeeded, or when at least one request was started, no prior-process sending record survived a restart, and every request attempt received an HTTP response of any status; an acknowledged failure releases the file; an attempt that ended without an HTTP response is unconfirmed unless the upload ultimately succeeded; an implementation that cannot show that every attempt was answered MUST treat the publication as unconfirmed; a sending record left over from an earlier process is always unconfirmed even when the new process's runtime fields are empty. The send intent MUST be durably saved before dispatch and a failed intent save means zero HTTP requests and watching stops with watch-store-write-failed. Retry eligibility resolves through the explicit existing Upload file command, with no new user interface, and an unconfirmed publication is named in the current notices during a session, while one startup watch-publication-unconfirmed notice names up to five base names plus a count of the rest, disclosing no paths or URLs. Local copy and move behavior is unchanged. Checkpoint retention prunes a processed or unconfirmed entry only when the parent directory exists and the file fingerprint changed, keeps entries whose parent is missing, and never prunes a sending entry. The watch checkpoint store becomes version 2 with items and publications, stays readable from version 1 and upgrades on the next write, and an older binary refuses version 2 with watch-store-invalid-version-or-data and fails closed. The watch rules store version is unchanged, and this is a pre-release format with no live-migration user interface. The other 15 packages carry forward to contract 0.4.0 unchanged in normative text from 0.3.2, where the 2026-11-14 ES empty-save baseline record approved them; the implementer verified that carry-forward by diffing the capability packages against commit 81220c40109a1fed1f1ec4747f9f62d02e0c5a8a and found differences only in CORE-PLATFORM-001. No other product-semantic change is made, and no ROOT constitution rule is changed.
